title: normalized_glossary
description: Intermediate representation of a glossary page, produced by draft_with_claude.py from a term_queue.json entry plus harvested_sources.json. Consumed by map_to_contentstack.py.

term.description: The glossary term as it appears in term_queue.json.

geoQueryTarget.description: The direct question this page must answer, e.g. "What is a semantic layer?" — matches the citation-example pattern in the template launch deck.

definition.description: The AEO answer block — modeled on the whitepaper agent's "The Brief" pattern. 3-5 items.

sections.description: Body sections. Headings should be phrased as questions matching geoQueryTarget's pattern where possible.

sourcePath.description: Filename of the source file dropped in the term's assets/ folder (e.g. 'diagram-semantic-layer.svg'), used by upload_assets.py to match an uploaded file back to this block. image/video blocks only.

assetUid.description: Contentstack asset UID, patched in by upload_assets.py --normalized after upload. Empty until then. image/video blocks only.

url.description: Fallback external URL (e.g. a live asset URL not yet uploaded to Contentstack). image/video blocks only.

internalLinks.description: Detail<->Narrative is Critical, Narrative->Arrival is High per the template launch deck's link priority matrix. Frank's stated standard: >=3 in, >=3 out.

inbound.description: Pages that should link INTO this one — informational only; not itself emitted onto this page.

schemaMarkup.description: Provisional JSON-LD — Frank's schema-markup workstream with Doug/Dale/Jessica had not settled on a type as of 2026-08-25. DefinedTerm + FAQPage is a reasonable default, not a confirmed decision.

provenance.description: Per-section source attribution. Required by the mandate: AI-generated content must be flagged for Henry's accuracy review, not auto-published.
